name: The Returning Gaze
meaning: Pepe returns to the payment stone to see whether its witness still holds.
reviewStep: Open and visually inspect the final full PNG and 512-pixel JPEG
visualReviewStatus: Final full PNG and decoded JPEG opened and inspected locally
reviewLimit: Local visual inspection and byte comparisons, not independent certification.
prompt: Generate a small isolated prehistoric cave-pigment motif on pure white, for addition to an existing cave wall: a single heavy-lidded watcher eye above a small irregular ochre pebble, surrounded by one incomplete sweeping oval loop that evokes returning to inspect the stone. Very simple primitive burnt-stick and thumb marks, sparse thick uneven charcoal outlines, rusty red ochre and yellow ochre pigment, worn gaps and grain. Flat hand-made Lascaux cave art, absolutely no shading or perspective. White background, generous whitespace. Only ONE eye and ONE pebble and ONE broken oval curve. No letters, numbers, captions, writing, logos, watermark, signatures, arrows, hands, handprints, people, frames, border, photorealism or 3D. This is a pigment-only addition asset, not the complete cave. Save generated bytes to artifacts/line-3/wall-v6.png if file output is supported.
digitReview: No hands or handprints added; inherited Pepe hands remain concealed. No visible digits to count.
visualObservations: Recognizable heavy-lidded, wide-mouthed Pepe retained. Added worn ochre/charcoal eye, stone and returning sweep on empty lower-left rock. Rock, cracks, light, colour, dimensions and framing inherited. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed.
